versions.changelog:
Initial release of the migrate-to-builds skill.

- Helps users test Cloud Agent environment compatibility with prebuilt environment builds and recommends required changes.
- Explains environment build flow, configuration source precedence, and proper use of install/start/terminals scripts.
- Provides diagnosis guidance for common setup mistakes and misplaced actions.
- Emphasizes safety, proper handling of secrets, and rigorous build validation procedures.
- Includes clear instructions for referencing environments and builds in user responses.
